headline: Iraola's Liverpool face a major test against City
summary: Liverpool face Manchester City at Anfield on 11 October with Andoni Iraola still unbeaten as manager. Sky Sports' review highlights three successive league clean sheets, bolder selection decisions and a team moving the ball forward faster. Sunday's game will test whether that improved defensive base can hold up against one of the title favourites.
